items.headline: Heat Advisory issued September 4 at 2:38PM EDT until September 4 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Wilmington NC
items.description:
* WHAT...Heat index values up to 109 expected.

* WHERE...Portions of southeast North Carolina and northeast South
Carolina.

* WHEN...For the first Heat Advisory, until 8 PM EDT this evening.
For the second Heat Advisory, from 11 AM to 8 PM EDT Saturday.

* IMPACTS...Hot temperatures and high humidity may cause heat
illnesses.
items.instruction:
Drink plenty of fluids, stay in an air-conditioned room, stay out of
the sun, and check up on relatives and neighbors.
